title: Sushruta’s Cancer “Cures” Exposed
description:
Can Ayurveda cure cancer? Ancient texts like the Sushruta Samhita describe cancer (called Arbudha) as caused by the imbalance of vata, pitta, and kapha, with bizarre treatments including bloodletting, leeches, cow urine, dove droppings, purgatives, maggots, and even scraping tumors with fire and metal. These are still taught in the BAMS syllabus approved by the AYUSH ministry.

Meanwhile, modern medicine has identified more than 100 types of cancer—from leukemia and lymphoma to melanoma and sarcoma—and explains them as genetic diseases caused by DNA mutations, environmental toxins, tobacco, alcohol, UV rays, or inherited genes. Thanks to clinical trials, chemotherapy, surgery, immunotherapy, radiation, and targeted therapies, survival rates are steadily improving, unlike Ayurveda’s medieval practices.

This video critically examines how Ayurveda treats cancer, exposes the pseudoscientific methods of Sushruta (hailed as the father of surgery), and shows why anecdotes and ancient claims cannot replace evidence-based oncology. If you’ve searched for Ayurveda cancer cure, Sushruta Samhita Arbudha, Ayurveda vs modern medicine, cancer treatment in Ayurveda, BAMS syllabus cancer, or Ayurvedic cancer quackery, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations!

Chapters
00:00 – Can Ayurveda cure cancer?
02:30 – What modern medicine knows about cancer
06:00 – Sushruta’s cancer treatments explained
10:20 – Bloodletting, cow urine, and maggot therapy
15:00 – Benign vs malignant tumors in Ayurveda
20:10 – Why BAMS syllabus still teaches this today
24:40 – Modern medicine vs pseudoscience
